settings_agents_agent_approval_descripti: Ask first: the agent waits for your OK before running commands or editing files. Auto-approve: it never asks, so use it only in worktrees you can throw away.
settings_agents_agent_args_description: Flags added every time {label} starts, for example --model opus.
settings_agents_agent_custom_description: Any agent CLI (OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Amp…). It starts from the + menu and {key} like the built-in ones. Without Atlas hooks its tab shows working while the terminal prints and idle after a few quiet seconds; to report real states it can run `atlas hook` (see docs/agents.md).
settings_agents_agent_default_descriptio: What a new agent tab starts. Blank terminal opens a plain shell.
settings_agents_agent_quick_add_hint: Examples: Run tests, Review my changes.
settings_agents_agent_quick_description: One-click buttons in the tab strip. Each one runs a command in a terminal, or sends a prompt to the agent.
settings_agents_crew_description: Crew servers run crewmates 24/7 on your own server. Add a crew server after running `atlas crew install user@host`.
settings_agents_crew_github_description: Connect GitHub so the crew can clone private repositories. Configure in the crew workspace footer.
settings_agents_crew_pause_hint_paused: Nothing runs on this server: queued tasks wait and automations are skipped.
settings_agents_crew_pause_hint_running: Cancels every running task and holds the queues until you resume.
settings_agents_crew_remove_confirm: Remove "{name}"? Crewmates on this server will stop being managed from here.
settings_agents_crew_remove_hint: Stops managing crewmates on this server.
settings_agents_crew_replay_description: Shows the Atlas Crew introduction again from the first step.
settings_agents_crew_target_description: Run `atlas crew install user@host` first, then add the server here.
settings_agents_mobile_description: Atlas Mobile shows the projects, logs and agents of {@common_os_your_computer} on your phone. As far as you allow, it can also restart services, run actions, watch and type in terminals and answer agent permission prompts. No account: the link between them is end-to-end encrypted.
settings_agents_mobile_empty_body: A paired phone can see your projects, logs and agents, restart services, run actions, watch and type in terminals and answer agent permission prompts, as far as you allow, from anywhere, while {@common_os_your_computer} is awake. Press {@mobile_pair_card_show_code} above to add one.
settings_agents_ssh_add_host_description: Choose one of the hosts already set up in your SSH config.
settings_agents_ssh_add_project_descript: The project then appears in your sidebar.
settings_agents_ssh_host_description: Which machine the project is on.
settings_agents_ssh_no_hosts_description: Pick a host from your SSH config below. Atlas never changes that file.
settings_agents_ssh_remote_project_descr: Add a project that lives on one of your hosts. The folder must contain an atlas.yaml.
